text_block_list.text:
On the way back to the academy, Tosen Jordan
seemed to take an interest in a certain poster...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Museum Special Exhibition", huh~?
Takes me back to our school trips~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, my homeroom teacher chewed me out over my book report, telling me to "take it seriously."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, stuff like "don't write about unrelated things"
or "look at the picture more closely~"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
When I read the piece written by the girl chosen from our class,
it was totally different from mine. Not that I care anymore, though.

She may have a casual vibe, but she isn't one
to slack off on assignments... Perhaps her sensibility
just wasn't conveyed well?
choice_data_list: ...Shall we go look at some art?
...Do you want to go look at some art?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? A painting?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, look.
Even if I watch, I won't understand it."

There is no single correct interpretation, so
I told her that she should cherish what she felt while watching the work.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Really?
Even though you got scolded for it?

This might be a good opportunity for her.
I decided to go to the art museum with her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...The feeling of not belonging is insane~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, we're already here, right? Might as well check it out while we can.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look. It's the academy's "Goddess Statue."
Did an alumna paint this?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it looks like a photo...
......Hm? Ah, I see...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Oho, I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "The Jungle and the Whispers"... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Crap, I think I get it now!
Watching this as an adult hits totally different!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well yeah, pictures speak for themselves, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"The one who drew the Goddess Statue was that, right?
The picture of a smartphone dropped in water, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"We tried to take a pic, but got way too hyped and dropped it in the water.
So we were like, 'Well, we still want a keepsake, so let's draw one instead! Woohoo!'"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alsooo, that blueish painting kinda looks like
what you see when you close your eyes
after staring at your phone forever, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And, Jungle's thing is... you know?
That 'Aa-aaah!' thing, you're doing it in secret, right? 'Cause it's embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Man, seeing it on a big screen really makes a difference!
...How should I answer?
...How should I answer?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right!? Pretty sick, huh!?
Am I a genius or what?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, art museums are pretty interesting~.
Using your imagination is super fun too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I just had a flash of inspiration,
so I'm gonna try it on my nails~!

"It was quite a bold interpretation...
but it seemed to serve as good inspiration for her."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that no good?
choice_data_list: No, no, it's not bad at all!
No, no, it's not no good at all!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Haha, so desperate~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine, you don't gotta say it.
Like... I already get it, you know?
What you were trying to tell me.

It felt as though I was able to help ease
her past hesitation, if only a little...
